## What's new

**Tokens are no longer stored in `server.json`.** The server keeps only a
fingerprint (SHA-256 hash) of each token, so someone who sees the config file
or a backup of it can't use it to log in.

- Nothing to do for existing users: the first time the 0.5.0 server starts,
  it converts the stored tokens to hashes by itself and logs one line.
  Everyone keeps logging in with the same token.
- `warren adduser` now shows a new token **only once**. If someone loses
  theirs, run `deluser` and `adduser` for them again.
- If you ever re-ran `setup.sh`, delete `/etc/warren/server.json.bak`: it's
  an old copy of the config that may still contain plain tokens. The server
  log reminds you if it finds one.

**Connection limits.** A flood of connections can no longer exhaust your
VPS or your friends' PCs:

- At most 1000 visitors per tunnel at once. Beyond that, game visitors are
  turned away and websites show a "too busy" page. Raise it with
  `"max_conns_per_tunnel"` in `server.json` (then restart warren) if you run
  a busy website.
- Visitors waiting for a slow client, and connections to the control port
  that never log in, are capped too.
- When a limit is reached, the server log says so (at most once a minute).

Normal use never gets near these limits.

> **Don't downgrade the server after updating.** Once 0.5.0 has converted
> the tokens, 0.4.0 and older can't read them, so nobody could log in.
> `warren update` and `setup.sh` always install the newest version, so this
> only matters if you install an old version by hand.

0.5.0 uses the same protocol as earlier versions, so clients don't have to
update at the same time as the server. The Minecraft mod hasn't changed
(still 0.2.0); it's included so everything is in one place.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `warren-windows-amd64.exe` | Windows |
| `warren-darwin-arm64` | Mac with Apple chip (M1–M4) |
| `warren-darwin-amd64` | Mac with Intel chip |
| `warren-linux-amd64` | Linux / most VPSes |
| `warren-linux-arm64` | Linux on ARM (Oracle Ampere, Hetzner ARM, Raspberry Pi 64-bit) |
| `warren-mod-0.2.0+mc1.21.11.jar` | Minecraft mod (Fabric 1.21.11, needs Fabric API) |
| `setup.sh` | VPS setup wizard |
| `SHA256SUMS` | checksums (also used by `warren update`) |
